QuestInfo.name: Agent W's Watermelon Investigation
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Admin said that #e#rMaster M#k#n has planted bombs Chumji's watermelons and asked you to retrieve them. Get to Chumji's watermelon field with the Maple Admin's help, then collect #b5 #t4031701##k and take it to #rAgent W#k at agent headquarters.\r\n#i4031701# #t4031701# #b#c4031701# / 5#k
QuestInfo.2: There was intelligence that #rMaster M#k planted a bomb in Chumji's watermelon field. You carefully picked 5 watermelons and delivered them to Agent W, who's a self proclaimed demolitions expert. You don't feel all that safe around him...

0.0: Hey! #b#h0##k. There's a rumor that #e#rMaster M's Bomb#k#n is hidden inside Chumji's watermelon field. How is that possible? Chumji practically watches over that field 24/7.  Agent W is investigating. Want to help him, #b#h0##k?

yes.0: I will send you to Chumji's watermelon field.  Avoid the Hoguls and carefully pick #b5 Watermelons#k, and take them to #rAgent W#k.  Tell me when you are ready to go.

1.0: Oh!  Be careful.  Any sudden movements can trigger the bomb.  Here...put it down here very carefully.

yes.0: Great work. It wasn't an easy mission but you managed it anyhow. Here, take this pink flower pattern tube that was distributed from headquarters.

npc.0: #rMaster M#k is said to have planted bombs in Chumji's watermelons.  We need to retrieve those watermelons immediately. I will send you to Chumji's watermelon field, collect #b5 #t4031701##k and take it to #rAgent W#k.

item.0: I believe you already heard everything from the Maple Admin.  Go inside Chumji's watermelon field with the help of the Maple Admin, and bring me back #b5 #t4031701##k that #rMaster M#k has planted bombs in.
